spec_match.rationale: Reads button.type per button from the real getGamepads() poll — the exact runtime contract — alongside index/pressed/touched/value, and implements the explainer's type-driven 'Press the touchpad' prompt.

interactive.rationale: gamepadconnected/disconnected listeners drive a requestAnimationFrame poll that live-renders every button row and the prompt banner; polling pauses when the tab is hidden.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises live per-button rendering including honest per-button 'attribute missing' — matches the implementation.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers no-pad waiting state, disconnect handling, flag-off honest type column, attribute-on-prototype-but-missing-on-instance, buttons beyond the standard mapping, and visibility-based poll suspension.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5075054393163776; page links siblings.

conformance.rationale: The hardware-dependent enum-vocabulary and trackpad contracts are honest manual assertions in the suite, mirroring exactly what this console lets a human verify.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run (no gamepad hardware in the environment): waiting state renders honestly, flag note visible, zero console errors, 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read. Hardware path not claimable and not claimed.

telemetry_health.rationale: gpbt-pad-read assert fires on first pad read with button count and mapping; no polling console noise.

design_system.rationale: Type colours (blue/emerald/amber) sit on near-white row backgrounds (AA); pressed cells flip both background and color; table scrolls in its own container.

accessibility.rationale: Real table with scoped headers and caption; status and prompt are aria-live; state words (true/false, type strings) are text, never colour-only.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The wide table scrolls inside .btn-table-wrap; page body has 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Exercise with real hardware: a standard pad and a DualSense
openQuestions.detail: The cloud verification environment has no gamepad. On hardware: verify rows render at ~60Hz, pressed cells invert, and with GamepadButtonTypes on a DualSense confirm exactly one 'trackpad' button flips the prompt banner.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Tie per-frame work to requestAnimationFrame and suspend it when not visible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Poll runs on rAF only while a pad exists and cancels on visibilitychange hidden; restarts on visible/connect.

guidanceConsulted.query: live data table updates screen reader
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep live-updating data in real table semantics with textual state and aria-live summaries.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Scoped-header table plus aria-live status/prompt lines carry the state textually; colours are reinforcement only.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp, no gamepad hardware in this cloud session): waiting state, flag note, and honest type-column downgrade all render with a clean console at both viewports; the rAF loop provably idles without a pad. Hardware verification (row updates, trackpad prompt) is recorded as the open question it genuinely is.
